ICS 01.040.13, 03.080.30, 13.060.20, 13.060.30SSD 14New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard defines terms common to the different stakeholders of the water utility with regards to,a) key elements and characteristics of the service to users; andb) the components of drinking water supply, wastewater and stormwater management systems.2. REFERENCESThe standard listed below contains provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the listed edition was valid. The standard is subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of the standard listed below:IS/ISO 19011 : 2018 Guidelines for auditing management systems (second revision)
